summary_en: 380,000 shares (3.0% S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-07-27 at ¥1,831/share ceiling, up to ¥700M outlay. Execution window 08:45 JST, single order. Part of expanded ¥1.2B authorization (660,000 shares, 5.2% S/O) approved same day.
title_en: Notice regarding expansion of acquisition framework for treasury shares and acquisition of treasury shares via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Bull-Dog Sauce announced on 24 July 2026 a one-day treasury share acquisition via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading. On the same day the board voted to expand the total authorization framework from ¥500M (280,000 shares) to ¥1.2B (660,000 shares, 5.2% of shares outstanding ex-treasury). The immediate block execution targets 380,000 shares (3.0% of ex-treasury S/O) for up to ¥700M at a ¥1,831/share price ceiling. Execution is scheduled for 27 July 2026 at 08:45 JST via a single ToSTNeT-3 order; results will be published immediately after the 08:45 close. The expanded authorization window runs from 18 May 2026 to 19 March 2027, with the company retaining the right to use open-market purchases alongside ToSTNeT-3 for the remaining authorized tranches. A shareholder indicated intent to sell, prompting the framework expansion.
